text.card: A red giant 1,607 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.17 solar masses and 11.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,737 K at its surface.
